_note: Only father_insight is authored. supporting_partner, connecting_with_baby and mission are omitted on purpose so they derive from the matching mother week (partnerCorner + babyDevelopment), which is already written and reviewed for all 37 weeks. See lib/models/father_week_derive.dart. Adding one of those keys here overrides the derivation for that section only.

title.en: Say the thing you keep not saying
title.hi: वह बात कह दीजिए जो आप कहते नहीं

body.en: Most fathers are carrying one worry they have decided not to mention. It does not get smaller by month nine. Say it this week, plainly, and let her carry half.
body.hi: ज़्यादातर पिता एक फ़िक्र अपने भीतर रखते हैं जिसे न कहने का फ़ैसला वे कर चुके हैं। नौवें महीने तक वह छोटी नहीं होती। इस हफ़्ते सीधे कह दीजिए, और आधा उन्हें उठाने दीजिए।
